name: GLUCOSAMINE / CHONDROITIN 1500/1200MG 15 ENVELOPES
description: This glucosamine (1500 mg) and chondroitin (1200 mg) dietary supplement, available in 15 sachets, is used to support joint health, as these compounds help maintain cartilage. It is an over-the-counter product and can be found in various pharmacies and online stores in Mexico. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
